ai.seo_question: Who is commanded to be cast into Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine justice meted out to the 'kaffar 'anid'—those who not only rejected faith but did so with stubborn arrogance, mirroring the fate of Pharaoh and his court. It serves as a vivid eschatological warning, emphasizing that persistent obstinacy in the face of clear signs leads to an inevitable and severe retribution in the Hereafter.
